component.name: EP800 Webcam Driver
component.summary: V4L2 driver for Creative Webcam PD1001 / Endpoints EP800 cameras

description.p: Out-of-tree Linux V4L2 driver for Endpoints EP800 USB cameras, including the Creative Webcam PD1001 (USB ID 041e:400d). Provides a /dev/video* capture device and exposes the camera shutter button as a KEY_CAMERA input event.
